tasks.spec:
You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. Do NOT run a formatter on YAML or markdown. You own only: data/stories/continuity-initiative/{knowledge.yaml,storylet-routes.yaml,storylets.md,world.yaml,handoffs.yaml}; files under tests/ (new tests/test_3a_records_followup.py, and existing tests you must update because the story changed); bench/affordance_known_gaps.json. Edit nothing else. Do NOT edit plot.md, pacing.yaml or any file under storygame/. Never hand-edit generated artifacts; edit authored sources only. Read docs/world-model-grounding.md and docs/markdown-story-authoring.md before declaring or placing anything.

PROBLEM. In scene 3A the storylet SL-3A-B has two realizations: k_sl_3a_b_r1 ('read the experiment records': asserts behavioral_experiments_known and conditioned_release_plan_known) and k_sl_3a_b_r2 ('enter the medical level': asserts only behavioral_experiments_known). A storylet fires on its first reveal and its sibling then stops being a candidate (storygame/runtime/knowledge.py `_candidates`: `item.source.storylet_id in state.fired_event_ids`). So after a player enters the medical level, 'Read/Examine/Open the experiment records.' can never earn anything (observed: nine such commands, all with 'This turn has no candidates'). More synonyms cannot help. The fix is structural: a separate follow-up storylet, the same technique as the 3C split of SL-3C-C into SL-3C-C and SL-3C-F.

YOUR TASK. Fix the 3A records dead end using package data.
- Preserve both existing SL-3A-B realizations and their current successful routes. Do not change them except to connect them to the records object (below).
- Add a separate, optional records storylet (suggest id SL-3A-B2; follow the id and file conventions of neighbouring storylets, in storylets.md, storylet-routes.yaml and knowledge.yaml). It is available only in 3A when: michelle_reached is true, behavioral_experiments_known is true, conditioned_release_plan_known is false. Apply these gates to the storylet's activation AND to its reveal's `requires`.
- Its reveal copies the existing k_sl_3a_b_r1 `action_evidence` groups and `earn_when` unchanged. Its effect asserts conditioned_release_plan_known only. Do NOT replay the medical-level event or its movement effects.
- Its delivery_text is this existing text, unchanged, byte for byte: \"Michelle shows Kristin experiment records. They prove planned survivors were conditioned to support Charles's story. The senior official waits among the government prisoners.\"
- Declare the experiment records as a physical object in world.yaml if no suitable declaration exists. Place it in the medical level in 3A (item_placements are authored per scene; follow how other 3A things such as the surface gates or the terminal are declared and placed, and the aliases/scoped-name conventions). Connect both records reveals (k_sl_3a_b_r1 and the new one) to that object where the reveal schema allows (entity_ids or equivalent; copy the pattern used by other reveals). Do not make a future object available just to silence validation; the name must not collide with or leak into other scenes (a bare common word is leak-scanned in earlier scenes: pick a scene-specific name).
- Keep the original records-first path: k_sl_3a_b_r1 already establishes both facts, so the follow-up must be unavailable afterward (conditioned_release_plan_known true).
- Keep the medical-level-to-official path (SL-3A-D needs behavioral_experiments_known). Do NOT make the follow-up a required step of any transition or resolution event. Do not change the timer or pacing. The follow-up is optional; if a loader rule demands it be reachable or backstopped, satisfy the rule the way other optional storylets do and report it in notes.md.
- Exactly one eligible reveal still wins; a command that matches two eligible reveals still awards neither. Do not change matcher behaviour (no runtime edits).

TESTS. Write tests/test_3a_records_followup.py that runs the REAL package through the real projector/matcher (look at tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py and neighbouring tests for how they load the package and drive reveals; copy their style). It must check: (1) after medical entry (k_sl_3a_b_r2 fired), each of these commands uniquely earns the follow-up reveal: 'Read the experiment records.', 'Examine the experiment records.', 'Open the experiment records.', 'Inspect the medical records.', 'Review the survivor records.' (2) records first still earns k_sl_3a_b_r1 and the follow-up is then not a candidate. (3) After the follow-up is earned, it is not a candidate again, and conditioned_release_plan_known is true. (4) Neither records reveal is eligible before michelle_reached / before their prerequisites. (5) The follow-up is not eligible when conditioned_release_plan_known is already true by either route. (6) Existing route medical entry -> official (k_sl_3a_d_r1 and the transition) still works without the follow-up. (7) The experiment records object is declared, placed in the medical level in 3A, and appears in the narrator's THINGS/context for 3A once the medical level is reached, and its protected contents (the statement/delivery text) do not appear in the pre-reveal narrator prompt. If you cannot check (7) with existing helpers, say so in notes.md rather than faking it. Do not pin counts of collected tests. Existing tests that encode the old story (counts of storylets/reveals, fixed lists) may be updated to include the new item: list each change in notes.md and why.

CORPUS DIFF. Also write scripts/ringer/affordance/3a_records_corpus_diff.py: replay the recorded player commands that exist in the repo (search artifacts/, bench/, and ~/dev/ringer-work/affordance-live-all/*.md for 3A turns; if no corpus is readable say so) through the matcher before (git stash is NOT allowed; instead build the old package from `git show HEAD:<path>` into a temp dir) and after, in their recorded states where recoverable, and print every command whose result changed. Put the printed list in notes.md and say which changes you judge intended. It need not run in the suite.

HOW TO RUN TESTS. In this sandbox `uv run` cannot write its cache or download. Use the main checkout's environment but make Python import THIS worktree's code: `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`. First run `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c \"import storygame,sys;print(storygame.__file__)\"` and confirm the path is inside your working directory; if not, stop and say so in notes.md. Use the same interpreter for ruff: `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix . && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format .` (ruff must not touch YAML or markdown; the repo is kept fully ruff-formatted). The full suite is slow when cores are shared; run it once at the end.

OUTPUT. Write notes.md at the worktree root: what you changed (file by file), the final test result (counts), each existing test you changed and why, the corpus-diff list, and anything you could not satisfy. Do not claim the suite passes unless you ran it and saw it pass.
tasks.verified: A separate optional 3A records storylet earns conditioned_release_plan_known after medical entry; records-first and medical-to-official paths unchanged; suite and ruff pass
